name: kanade-foods-v8-mulund-vercel
description: Professional customer ordering UI inspired by familiar quick-commerce patterns: - Location-first experience, restricted to Mulund - Four categories: Fresh Cut Vegetables, Fresh Cut Fruits, Ready-to-Cook Mixes, Fresh Sprouts - Search, category tabs, cart drawer, quantity controls - Product card shows “1 added”, “2 added”, etc. after adding - Cart displays 1kg instead of 1000g - WhatsApp checkout uses 8104130330 - Mobile responsive - Supplied Kanade Foods logo integrated
